notes.title: 2025/08/04 Update & Optimization
notes.content:
[p]2025/08/04 Update & Optimization[/p][olist][*][p]Mech Mode parameter tuning
• Shell-resupply activation time reduced to 10 s.
• When not taking damage, HP auto-regenerates 2/200 per second.
• New “Easy Difficulty” lets you call in AI mech teammates for support.[/p][/*][*][p]Roach control update
• Default camera now follows terrain and mouse movement.
• Press V to toggle back to the original control scheme.
• Mouse-wheel adjusts camera zoom.[/p][/*][*][p]Roach Mode difficulty lowered
• Time needed to activate a nest halved.
• Energy required to charge skills halved.
• Rapid HP regeneration when out of danger.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial page guidance refined.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: 2025/07/22 Update
notes.content:
[olist][*][p][b]Removed[/b] energy cost for attacking and sprinting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced[/b] energy regen to 10 per second (out of 100 max).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lowered[/b] mech HP to [b]200[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ammo packs now respawn every 60 s[/b] when none are available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extended[/b] mech ability duration to [b]40 s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added[/b] cockroach camera-rotation toggle ([b]V[/b] to switch).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster[/b] transition from walk to sprint.[/p][p]
…More improvements on the way![/p][/*][/olist]
